/ Evidence trail

What the project makes inspectable.

Constraint

Scattered prompts and instruction files can guide an agent, but they do not provide one source of truth or evidence that repository rules were followed.

Construction

Beryl installs a durable control plane for task routing, project context, deterministic checks, test-manifest protection, and optional local Git hooks—while preserving human review.

Published evidence

Teams get a repeatable loop of intent, bounded changes, checks, evidence, and signoff that is inspectable in the repository instead of trapped in chat history.
